title.value: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF PFAS IN CERTAIN PRODUCTS
title.provenance: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF PFAS IN CERTAIN PRODUCTS.

status.provenance: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives in General Assembly convened

pfas_definition.provenance: "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" or "PFAS" means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: On and after January 1, 2026, no person shall distribute, sell or offer for sale in this state any new or not-previously-used outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions that contains PFAS unless such product is accompanied by a legible and easily discernable disclosure with the statement "Made with PFAS chemicals"

who.provenance: if a manufacturer or other person sells turnout gear that contains intentionally added PFAS, the manufacturer or person shall provide written notice to the purchaser

action.provenance: no person shall distribute, sell or offer for sale in this state any new or not-previously-used outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions that contains PFAS
